' ke hisse ke roop mein karte hain.

Hum stress ya khatre ke prati apni reactions par gaur karna chahte hain. Kya hum ladte hain, bhaagte hain, ya jam (freeze) jaate hain? Kya humne hamesha aise hi react kiya hai, ya baar-baar hue anubhavon ne humein yeh sikhaya hai? Kya hum aise hi khud ko surakshit rakhna seekh gaye hain? Hamara lakshya yeh samajhna hai ki hamara shareer 3F sthiti (fight, flight ya freeze — ladna, bhaagna ya jam jaana) mein kaise aur kyun jaata hai.

Pehchaniye ki jab aap khatre mein ya ghabraye hue hote hain to vo kaisa 'mehsoos' hota hai, taaki aap apne shareer ki reactions ko jaan sakein. Inn bhaavnaon ko pehle se samajhna matlab hum us pal mein apna khayal rakh sakte hain.
Apne shareer mein stress response kaisa mehsoos hota hai, use draw kariye. Prerna ke liye neeche diya gaya udaharan (stick figure) dekhiye.

Sochiye ki aapmein yeh stress response kaun si cheez trigger karti hai. Kya aap pehle se jaante hain ki kis cheez se aapko stress hota hai? Yeh padosiyon ko chillate hue sunna ho sakta hai, ya kaam par koi feedback milna.

Agar aap abhi tak kuch pehchaan nahi paaye hain, to koi baat nahi. Hum dheere-dheere apne mann ko khol rahe hain — khud ko jaanne ke liye, aur yeh samajhne ke liye ki hum stress par kaise react karte hain. Agar iss prakriya mein samay lagta hai, to yeh theek hai.
